partners.name: ProSwimwear
partners.intro: For club members. Set this up once, then shop signed in.
steps: Fill in the club member form at https://www.proswimwear.co.uk/10-discount-for-swim-club-members. Pick “Ice Warriors” and use the same email.
Wait up to 2 working days. After the confirmation email, 10% comes off automatically whenever you’re signed in.
partners.note: No code needed. Can’t be combined with other discount codes.
